reviews.comment: I'm not quite sure Dr. Pope has learned how to use Canvas since the University adopted it. He is a great lecturer, and knows what he is talking about, but his online classroom is disorganized, and it is often hard to know what work needs to be done for the class.

Great professor despite all the bad reviews! Such a caring guy who is passionate about what he teaches. Assignments were not too difficult and were group work. Gave us exactly what we needed to succeed in his class.

Dr. Pope is such a sweetheart, this is his last year teaching so I understand this review isn't going to be helpful for future students... I just want to highlight that even though he lectures straight from the slides he tries his best to make class fun and engaging.

He lectures straight from the slides that are available in canvas. Quiz after every module, usually one every Friday (pretty easy). Stopped going to class and studied myself because if you understand the basics of the material you will do fine. Only studied 3 days before each exam and still did fine. 5 sheets of notes allowed per exam. EASY A

Not a terrible professor, however, he only reads off his lecture slides, with little to no expansion on the topics. There are quizzes after each module, but he will drop your 3 lowest. Group projects are easy enough and require little to no actual effort. 3 total exams, each are noncumulative, and you can bring in 5 sheets of notes.

To put things in perspective, I am a Computer Science student and this was one of my hardest classes this semester. He is very disorganized when it comes to assignments, takes a VERY long time with grading, and his lecture slides are way too long. Not worth the effort.

Takes months to grade anything. Made us retake an exam because he wanted it in a certain format and messed it up. As a junior in a freshman-level class, I shouldn't be struggling this much. Each presentation has over 100 slides each some up to 150.6 group projects aren't too hard. The quizzes are pretty difficult I never got better than a C on them
Terrible professor! DO NOT TAKE! He has no respect for his students and will take months to grade anything!!

His portion of 306 was noticeably harder than Dr. Julia Reece's portion. He gives good enough lectures to make good grades on his exams. Carbonates have always given me more trouble than siliciclastics but he made them understandable. Lectures can be a bit mundane. Exams are reasonable. The textbook helped a lot. Very respected within the dept.
